text: How To Restart A Dead Chat With Her
“Looks like we both vanished. I’ll take the fall for it.”
“You crossed my mind today. What’s been happening in your world?”
“We ignoring each other forever or should I restart this?”
note: Bold enough to get a reaction.

text: “Just remembered something stupid we laughed about. That memory hit different.”
“Kinda weird how we stopped talking. I’m fixing that now.”
“I almost texted earlier... then my brain overthought it.”
“If I text you now, don’t act like you weren’t waiting.”
